title: Statements, Collections and Permitted Balance Adjustments on the Insured Plan of Care
content:
**Patient Accounts Manual — Insured Plan of Care, statements and adjustments.**

## Statements and collections

Statements are issued on an open patient balance every statement cycle of the payer program, in calendar days, numbered from 1 for that balance; the statement whose number equals the payer program's statements-before-collections count is the final notice. An unpaid balance is transferred to collections no earlier than the statement cycle, in calendar days, after the issue date of the final statement. Days are counted as calendar days from the statement date, the statement date itself being day zero. A balance on a Patient Payment Plan in good standing or under a pending hardship application is never transferred.

Where the payer program allows a small-balance write-off, a balance at or below the payer program's small-balance maximum still open after the final statement is written off as a small-balance write-off instead of being transferred.

## Adjustments — the complete list

An amount leaves the patient's balance without a payment only as one of these adjustments; no other adjustment kind exists, and copays are never waived as a courtesy.

| Adjustment | When it is posted |
|---|---|
| Small-balance write-off | A balance at or below the small-balance maximum still open after the final statement, where the payer program allows it |
| Billing error correction | A charge posted above what the payer's explanation of benefits or the benefits on file support is corrected by a billing error correction for the excess |
| Timely filing write-off | A charge for a visit whose claim missed the timely filing period is removed in full |
| Hardship discount | Only from an approved Patient Hardship Discount Program determination, and only where the payer program allows hardship adjustments |
| Transfer to payment plan | Moves the enrolled amount of a charge into a Patient Payment Plan, only where the payer program allows payment plan transfers |

**Evidence.** The issue dates and sequence numbers of the plan's statements are read from the plan's system records.

## Collections timing — boundary (hypothetical dates, 30-calendar-day statement cycle)

| Final statement issued | Date considered | Day count | Transfer to collections |
|---|---|---|---|
| 2026-04-01 (day zero) | 2026-04-30 | day 29 | Not yet |
| 2026-04-01 (day zero) | 2026-05-01 | day 30 | Allowed from this day |

## Points of judgement

- A hypothetical $7.50 balance on a commercial program still open after the final statement is written off as a small-balance write-off rather than transferred, since it is at or below the $9.99 maximum scheduled for those programs.
- A balance enrolled in a Patient Payment Plan in good standing is not transferred, whatever its age.
